create_usd_exporter: create a USDExporter instance to convert a MuJoCo MjModel scene into USD format
run_update_scene: run update_scene with MjData to sync MuJoCo simulation state into the USD stage
save_scene: save the USD scene to a file in usd, usda, or usdc format
add_light: add a user-defined sphere or dome light to the USD scene at a given position
add_camera: add a user-defined camera to the USD scene with a given position and euler rotation
